title: Linear Pattern Centermark
description: Defines a linear pattern of centermarks over a row of circular edges, with connecting lines between consecutive marks.

circularEdges.description: Circular edges the pattern connects (at least two). Required on create; optional on edit (the current circular edges are kept when omitted). On an automatic pattern they cannot be changed.

showConnectingLines.description: Whether the connecting lines between marks are shown.

connectingLines.description: Logical ids of the connecting-line segments between consecutive centermarks, including those hidden by break lines. Export only: computed from the circular edges and their centermarks, ignored on create/edit.

items.description: Logical id of a connecting line, used to reference it from other annotations.

centermarks.description: Centermarks that belong to this linear pattern. Export only.

items.description: Logical id of a centermark in the pattern

isAutomatic.description: True if the pattern was generated automatically. Export only.

isHidden.description: True if the pattern is hidden in its view: an automatic pattern when the view hides its automatic centermarks, or any pattern whose part is hidden in the view. A hidden pattern cannot be edited. Export only.
